subject: Re: Demo booking conflict — GlossyHome inbound signup
body:
-----Original Message-----
From: Samir Rao <samir@glossyhome.com>
To: hello@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 17 Aug 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: [Signup] Schedule demo — GlossyHome

Hi Redwood team,

I just signed up through the site and booked a demo for Monday 8/20 at 10am PT. The confirmation shows ‘AE: Auto-assign’. Can someone confirm who will own this? We’re evaluating inference options and want an AE who understands on-prem needs.

Thanks,
Samir
Director of Platform
GlossyHome

---
Message 2
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
To: Samir Rao <samir@glossyhome.com>
Cc: avery_johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 17 Aug 2028 09:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: [Signup] Schedule demo — GlossyHome

Samir — welcome and thanks for signing up. I’m Soojin on the SDR team, I’ll be your point to confirm logistics. I see the calendar event is for Mon 8/20 10:00am PT (30m). Quick notes:
- We can expand to 45m if you want an on-prem deep-dive.
- Do you prefer an AE who’s handled regulated retail deployments? I can loop them in now.

If you’re flexible, I can move to 8/21 at 9:30am PT to align with AE availability. Would you like me to reschedule?

—
Soojin Lee
SDR, Redwood Inference

---
Message 3
From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>, Samir Rao <samir@glossyhome.com>
Date: Fri, 17 Aug 2028 09:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: [Signup] Schedule demo — GlossyHome

Looping here — I had Brightline (separate account) flagged in my territory and I see the automatic assignment gave me this AE slot. I’m happy to own the call Monday — I’ve worked with retailers on on-prem constraints.

If Samir is open to Monday, I’ll take the 30m and follow up with an expanded technical session later.

Avery Johnson
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

---
Message 4
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>, Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>, Samir Rao <samir@glossyhome.com>
Date: Fri, 17 Aug 2028 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: [Signup] Schedule demo — GlossyHome

Quick flag — GlossyHome is actually in my named territory (see map attached). The inbound routing sometimes misfires when accounts are on the edge of zone boundaries. I’ll need the opportunity to handle the discovery — can we move the AE assignment to me? I can do 8/20 but prefer 8/21 9:30am PT for a fuller run-through.

Attachment: territory_map.png (image)

Marcus Lin
Senior AE, Redwood Inference

---
Message 5
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Samir Rao <samir@glossyhome.com>
Date: Fri, 17 Aug 2028 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: [Signup] Schedule demo — GlossyHome

Thanks both — quick suggested path to avoid spamming the prospect:
1) Marcus, can you confirm territory ownership with the GTM map by EOD?
2) If confirmed, Avery — can you transfer the calendar event to Marcus (I’ll handle the reschedule ping to Samir)?
3) Samir — would 8/21 9:30am PT work? If yes, I’ll send an updated invite and include a 45m slot + technical follow-up placeholder.

I’m attaching a snapshot of the current invite so we don’t lose the original meeting id.

Attachments: glossy_demo_snapshot.ics, redwood-demo-brief.pdf

—
Soojin

---
Message 6
From: Samir Rao <samir@glossyhome.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Aug 2028 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Demo booking conflict — GlossyHome inbound signup

Thanks for the quick coordination — 8/21 at 9:30am PT works for us. Prefer a 45m session and would like the AE who’s doing on-prem work to join.

Samir

---
Resolution note (internal):
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
To: avery_johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Aug 2028 14:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: assignment and calendar ownership

Marcus confirmed territory ownership via GTM map (Slack DM). Avery will hand off the original event and Marcus will send the updated invite for 8/21 9:30am PT (45m) and include a technical follow-up slot. Case closed — recorded in HubSpot DEAL-112233 and added note: "auto-assign misroute; territory corrected."

Actions: Marcus to update HubSpot owner and send invite. Soojin to mark contact as "high-priority retail" in CRM.

"This thread contains attachments: glossy_demo_snapshot.ics (calendar export), redwood-demo-brief.pdf (demo brief)."
